# rightShift

> Perform bitwise shift to the right on a 64-bit unsigned integer.

<section class="intro">

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var rightShift = require( '@stdlib/number/uint64/base/right-shift' );
```

#### rightShift( a, shift )

Performs bitwise shift to the right on a 64-bit unsigned integer.

```javascript
var Uint64 = require( '@stdlib/number/uint64/ctor' );

var a = new Uint64( 10 );

var v = rightShift( a, 1 );
// returns <Uint64>[ 5n ]
```

#### rightShift.assign( ah, al, shift, out, stride, offset )

Performs bitwise shift to the right on a 64-bit unsigned integer and assigns results to a provided output array.

```javascript
var Uint32Array = require( '@stdlib/array/uint32' );

var out = new Uint32Array( 2 );
var v = rightShift.assign( 2, 4, 1, out, 1, 0 );
// returns <Uint32Array>[ 1, 2 ]

var bool = ( out === v );
// returns true
```

The function supports the following parameters:

-   **ah**: high 32-bit word of the 64-bit unsigned integer.
-   **al**: low 32-bit word of the 64-bit unsigned integer.
-   **shift**: number of bits to shift (0-63).
-   **out**: output array.
-   **stride**: stride length for `out`.
-   **offset**: starting index for `out`.

#### rightShift.strided( a, sa, oa, shift, out, so, oo )

Performs bitwise shift to the right on a 64-bit unsigned integer stored in integer-valued strided array views and assigns results to a provided strided output array.

```javascript
var Uint32Array = require( '@stdlib/array/uint32' );

var a = new Uint32Array( [ 2, 4 ] );
var out = new Uint32Array( 2 );

var v = rightShift.strided( a, 1, 0, 1, out, 1, 0 );
// returns <Uint32Array>[ 1, 2 ]

var bool = ( out === v );
// returns true
```

The function supports the following parameters:

-   **a**: 64-bit unsigned integer strided array view containing interleaved 32-bit unsigned integer high and low order words.
-   **sa**: stride length for `a`.
-   **oa**: starting index for `a`.
-   **shift**: number of bits to shift (0-63).
-   **out**: output array.
-   **so**: stride length for `out`.
-   **oo**: starting index for `out`.

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<!-- Package usage notes. Make sure to keep an empty line after the `section` element and another before the `/section` close. -->

<section class="notes">

## Notes

-   If provided a shift value less than `0` or greater than `63`, only the `6` least significant bits are used.

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

```javascript
var zeroTo = require( '@stdlib/array/zero-to' );
var logEachMap = require( '@stdlib/console/log-each-map' );
var Uint64 = require( '@stdlib/number/uint64/ctor' );
var rightShift = require( '@stdlib/number/uint64/base/right-shift' );

var a = Uint64.of( 0xdeadbeef, 0x0badf00d );
// returns <Uint64>

var shifts = zeroTo( 64, 'uint32' );
// returns <Uint32Array>

logEachMap( 'rightShift(%x, %s) = %b', a, shifts, rightShift );
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->
